PF2E_AURA_FORGE.Name: Name
PF2E_AURA_FORGE.PresenceEffectsHint: These effects continuously apply while a valid target remains inside the aura. One-shot damage and instant death are event components and are not executed as Presence Effects; use an Event Effect instead.
PF2E_AURA_FORGE.TriggersHint: Triggers react to discrete events. Saves, degrees of success, and temporary immunity belong to the trigger; the effect itself is provided by Effect Forge. Direct damage and instant death execute exactly once per triggered event here.
PF2E_AURA_FORGE.Label: Label
PF2E_AURA_FORGE.EmbeddedEffectEditorHint: This is the Effect Forge embedded editor directly. Persistence and aura workflow remain owned by Aura Forge.

Notifications.GmOnly: Aura Forge can only be opened by a GM.

PF2E_AURA_FORGE.ActorAssignmentHint: Assign the saved aura to an Actor as a concrete aura instance. Instances reference the central definition and can be enabled or disabled independently.
PF2E_AURA_FORGE.SaveBeforeAssignHint: Save changes before assigning the aura.
PF2E_AURA_FORGE.NoAssignments: This aura is not currently assigned to any Actor.
PF2E_AURA_FORGE.SaveAuraToAssign: Save the aura first before assigning it to Actors.
PF2E_AURA_FORGE.DropActorHint: Drag an actor from the Actor Directory into this area to assign the aura.
PF2E_AURA_FORGE.DirectTriggerHint: Without a saving throw, runtime uses the Success effect as the direct event effect. Enter, leave, turn start, and turn end are executed automatically. Temporary immunities are tracked as visible PF2e effects and suppress further event effects from the matching aura while active.
PF2E_AURA_FORGE.ImmunityPresenceInteractionHint: When this immunity is granted, matching presence effects are removed immediately. When the immunity expires, they are applied again if the target is still inside the aura.
